policy.latest: The newest accepted regular product increment is draft=false, prerelease=false and must resolve from GitHub /releases/latest after publication.
policy.draft: Draft releases are preparation only and must never be described as public or current.
policy.prerelease: Prereleases are optional preview artifacts and must never be described as regular Latest.

claimEvidence.claim: ChimpMaera ships digest-bound Verification Fabric contracts plus a Shadow-only Evidence-DAG impact planner that explains selected verification nodes while keeping the complete suite authoritative.
claimEvidence.userValue: Maintainers get an auditable verification vocabulary and deterministic impact plan; uncertainty falls back to full validation instead of silently omitting checks.

functionalProof.result: PASS 16/16: v1 contract bundles and v2 Evidence-DAG plans verify; a real release-branch Shadow run executed the authoritative 304/304 comparator.

safetyProof.result: PASS 13/13 v2 selector/mutation probes plus v1 negatives: central, unmapped, unsafe, ambiguous, invalid, cyclic, drifting and selector-failure inputs over-select or FULL_FALLBACK.

nonClaims: Shadow-only local deterministic proof with 0/24 activation samples; no authoritative incremental skipping, result reuse, latency SLO, production readiness, security certification or external authority is proven.

safetyProof.result: PASS: unsupported versions, mutable targets, digest drift and authority deltas are denied with typed fail-closed results.
